title: Three permanence operations for closed subsets proper over a base: for f : X -> Y between S-schemes locally of finite type, images of S-proper closed subsets are S-proper closed when Y is separated over S or f is universally closed, and inverse images of S-proper closed subsets under proper f are S-proper closed.

core_obligations: Prove (1) via reduced induced structure and the scheme-theoretic image criterion.
Run the factorization Z -> Z'' -> f(Z) of part (2) and verify separated, quasi-compact, locally of finite type, universally closed for f(Z) -> S one at a time.
Prove (3) via base change and composition of proper morphisms.

proof_roadmap.step: Prove (1) via reduced induced structure and the scheme-theoretic image criterion.
Run the factorization Z -> Z'' -> f(Z) of part (2) and verify separated, quasi-compact, locally of finite type, universally closed for f(Z) -> S one at a time.
Prove (3) via base change and composition of proper morphisms.

difficulty_reason: All three parts are argued in the span: (1) endow Z with the reduced induced structure and apply the scheme-theoretic-image-proper lemma of the Morphisms chapter; (2) the detailed part: Z'' = f^{-1}(f(Z)) maps universally closed onto f(Z) as a base change of f, so Z -> f(Z) is universally closed by factorization through the closed immersion Z -> Z'', separatedness of f(Z) -> S comes from the image-universally-closed lemma, quasi-compactness descends from the surjection Z -> f(Z), local finite type is a composition statement, and universal closedness of f(Z) -> S follows from that of Z -> S via the image-proper-is-proper lemma; (3) pullback properness by base change plus composition.

dedup.scope: Functoriality of the class of closed subsets proper over a base under images (two hypotheses) and inverse images.
